column2: *** Valparaiso, Chile. Death Records September-December 1894 ***, DGS film 004702100, image 19, ark 3:1:939K-P9FG-8. Entry *** 54, page 28 ***, 'Rejistro de DEFUNCIONES en la Circunscripcion de *** EL ALMENDRAL ***, departamento de Valparaiso'. *** A PRINTED FORM, PLATE READ 9 October 2026 ***: nombre *** Lerena Diaz Juan Fernando ***, sexo masculino, nacionalidad *** CHILENA ***, edad *** diez meses ***, estado parvulo, domicilio *** Victoria, ochenta y uno ***; '*** Nombre de sus padres: padre ARTURO LERENA GARCIA, madre AMALIA DIAZ ***'. Died *** 18 September 1894 at one in the afternoon ***, of *** pulmonia ***; buried *** Playa Ancha ***.
column3: *** THE FATHER'S COMPOUND SURNAME NAMES HIS MOTHER: GARCIA. *** That is the first thing this archive has ever had about Arturo Lerena's parents, and it is a searchable handle. *** AND IT CONFIRMS THE WITHDRAWAL OF 13 SEPTEMBER: *** a man written LERENA GARCIA is not a son of *** AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***. The conflation was correctly undone, and now it is undone on evidence.

column1: *** AND A COUNTRY THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER OPENED ***
column2: The family is at *** 81 Victoria, El Almendral, VALPARAISO, CHILE *** in September 1894, and the dead child is *** CHILENA *** by nationality
column3: *** CHILE HAS APPEARED IN THIS ARCHIVE ONLY AS A SURNAME-DISTRIBUTION FIGURE AND A DNA PROBE. *** It has never been a place where a record was read. *** IT IS NOW, AND IT WAS REACHED WITHOUT LOOKING FOR IT *** - by a parent-pair query that was aimed at Argentina.

column1: *** AND IT MOVES THE FAMILY ACROSS THE ANDES AND BACK ***
column2: The drawer gave three sons: *** Alejandro Guillermo, La Pampa 1889; Diaz Arturo, Mendoza 1896; Vicente, Entre Rios 1897. *** This act adds *** JUAN FERNANDO, born in Chile about November 1893 *** - ten months old on 18 September 1894.
column3: *** LA PAMPA 1889, VALPARAISO 1893-94, MENDOZA 1896, ENTRE RIOS 1897. *** *** MENDOZA IS THE ARGENTINE CITY AT THE FOOT OF THE PASS TO VALPARAISO ***, so the route is the ordinary one and the dates sit in order. *** AND THE INDEX'S BIRTH YEAR IS A YEAR OUT: *** it estimates 1894 from the death year; the act says ten months, which is about November 1893.

column1: *** AND MORE CHILDREN THAN THE DRAWER SHOWED ***
column2: The same parent-pair query returns, across Chile and Entre Rios: *** MERCEDES LERENA DIAZ, JORJE VICENTE LERENA, ANTONIO LERENA DIAZ, SOLEDAD ESTRELLA LERENA DIAZ, ARTURO LERENA DIAZ *** and a *** FERNANDO JUAN LERENA DIAZ *** beside the Juan Fernando read here
column3: *** THE ARMY DRAWER SHOWS ONLY SONS OF ENROLMENT AGE. THE CIVIL REGISTERS SHOW THE FAMILY. *** *** INDEX ONLY - NONE OF THESE ACTS IS OPENED HERE ***, and 'Fernando Juan' beside 'Juan Fernando' may be one child indexed twice or two children, which is exactly the kind of thing this archive will not decide from an index.

column2: The Chilean form gives *** nacionalidad for the DECEASED only ***. It does not ask where the father was born.
column3: *** SO ARTURO LERENA GARCIA IS NOT YET PLACED IN A COUNTRY ***, where Carlos Lerena was placed in a city the same afternoon. *** WHAT WOULD PLACE HIM: *** his own marriage to Amalia Diaz, which would name his parents and his origin; or any of the Entre Rios civil registrations of his other children, which in that province routinely give the parents' nationality. *** HE IS RECORDED AS A LERENA GARCIA AND NOTHING MORE. ***
